text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking back to the academy with
Manhattan
Cafe, when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stops in her tracks, and I follow her
gaze to
see a gardening store.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... Would it be okay if we had a look
in there?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
choice_data_list: Of course, sounds good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I try to remember whether she's
always had
an interest in gardening, the
two of us step inside
the shop.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After comparing several brands of
fertilizer,
Manhattan Cafe leaves with a
few bags in hand.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Good thing they had the fertilizer I
was
looking
for.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm growing a coffee plant in the dorm...
choice_data_list: What are you growing?
What are you growing?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Once it bears fruit,
I'll be able to harvest
the
cherries...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The seeds inside those cherries are
where coffee
beans come from...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like the perfect plant for a
coffee lover
like her, and I can tell she's
excited by the way
she's talking about it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It takes around... three years for it to
bear fruit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And you can only harvest the cherries
once a
year...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: It must be very precious.
It's very precious, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's why the roast I make with those
beans...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Will make for a very special,
one-of-a-kind
drink...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Will make for a very special,
one-of-a-kind
drink...
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to drinking it.
I'm looking forward to drinking it...
It's amazing that you made all of ...
It's amazing that you made all of ...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to drinking it.
I'm looking forward to drinking it...
It's amazing that you made all of ...
It's amazing that you made all of ...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a hobbyist,
though... I can't say if
they'll
taste any better than
store-bought beans...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But there's a certain flavor... that can't
be
described in terms of deliciousness
alone...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: That's a privilege only the one wh...
That's a privilege only the one wh...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... if...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe mumbles something,
but it's too
quiet to hear.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing.
choice_data_list: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The voices... There are a lot of them
now... I think
it's time to head back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious to know what she said, but it
wouldn't be polite to press her. Ending
the conversation
there, we return to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Not really...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Some of my plants don't make the
winter... or
they get leaf scorch... or
pests get to them...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've tried growing plants many times,
only to fail...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No, I haven't.
choice_data_list: Still, you've kept taking care of ...
Still, you've kept taking care of ...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The struggle... makes the harvest that
much more
rewarding...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Because I get to savor coffee that's all
my own...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
choice_data_list: Hope we get a smooth harvest this ...
I hope we get a smooth harvest thi...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... if...

text_block_list.text: ...Nothing.
